kusaka.p: [Kusa+ṇvu] (pu) CL=7 A kind of grass (such as a palm, or coconut).

B:
kusaka： kusaka（pu）
ကုသက（ပု）
[kusa+ṇvu]
[ကုသ+ဏွု]
K:
kusaka：ကုသက （ပု）
[ကုသ+ဏွု]
（ထန်းအုန်းစသော） မြက်မျိုး။
DOP: kusaka m. [kusa 1 + ka 2 ], a grass-like plant; a tree of the ‘grass’ genus (cf S. lex. tṛṇadruma, tṛṇavṛkṣa); Vv-a 162, 7 (°-suphullitalatāvalambinīhī ti [Vv 35:5] ~ehi tālanāḷikerādīhi tiṇajātīhi olambamānāhi santānakavalli-ādīhi suṭṭhu kusumitalatāhi ca).

kusakaṇṭaka.p: [Kusa+kaṇṭaka] (pu) CL=7 (1) A sharp blade of a Kusu grass. (Ti) (2) With a sharp blade of a Kusu grass.
a: ကုသကဏ္ဋက(ပု)
